title: NKP Operations-Monitoring POC
content:
Introduction:

As part of IPEX initiative to provide an organizational level monitoring capability of all the business solution (Planners), it was decided to identify the right solution to monitor the IPEX planners in a more effective and consolidated way than today.

Key requirements were identified and a first line of discussion happened between IPEX monitoring team and appdynamics (INGKA) MoM-APM Meeting Appdynamics . One of the key outcome was to conduct and small scale POC with few important requirements from Kitchen solution area/NKP.

Purpose:

The purpose of this document is to draft the POC scenarios and define the acceptance criteria for a better understanding of the solution under evaluation.

Requirement

Objective

Expected Output

Measurement matrices

Acceptance criteria

Application Availability

The primary objective of this requirement is to monitor whether the product is available or accessible by the end user.

  1. KIOSK

  2. Home Users

Application Dashboard with traffic lights:

Red: Problem/application not accessible to end user. Orange: Application is accessible with custom breaches.

Green: All good

Application Performance synthetic monitoring

Real time application performance measurement from various locations

Locations:

  1. Store

  2. Multiple nodes and various geo locations

Performance Dashboard with Response time graph for chosen Use cases. Defined Boundary condition to showcase breach in NFR. Trend analysis with filtering on:

1. Market

2. Scenario/Use case

3. Individual HTTP request related stack trace and data.

4. Date and time filtering

  1. Response time for identified use cases.

  2. Webpage Response time transport layer.

  3. Browser rendering time

  4. DNS lookup time

  5. #of failed requests with trace

  6. # of static component failure with trace

  7. # of concurrent connections

  8. HTTP response code for each request

  9. TBD

NKP Business Scenario or user flow

User Scenario under evaluation for synthetic monitoring and availability POC:

Scenario 1:  NKP Landing Page/Invoke NKP

Measurement start: Enter the URL in the browser (Chrome or MS Edge) https://kitchen.planner.ikea.com/planner/#/gb/en/?plannerEnv=main

Entry point authentication Userid: frontenduser pwd: dropd2017

Measurement End: When the planner loads completely with browser rendering as shown below.

 

 Scenario 2:  Design from Scratch

Measurement Start: Click on the top right corner on the landing page. Measurement start when the user clicks the link.

Measurement End: When the planner loads completely in default view with browser rendering (can be 2D or 3D, currently default view is 2D)

 

Scenario 3:  Choose a Favourite/Auto Proposal

Measurement Start: When the user clicks on the tab “Choose a Favourite” and finishes click on “Don’t add”

Measurement End: When the entire Auto proposal is loaded into the planning area completely, with browser rendering completed for all cabinets and furniture along with “pricing information displayed”

 

 Scenario 4:  Add a Cabinet

Starting from landing page and after the user clicks on “Design from scratch” the user must click on “Make it yours”

After that explore the “Left Menu Option”

Measurement Start: Click on a cabinet to add. Measurement starts when the user has finished clicking on the cabinet to add to the planning area. 

Measurement End: When the item has been added to the planning area completely (rendering completed) with pricing information being displayed on the top right corner.

 

 

 Scenario 5: View Item List

Populate the planner with 15 cabinets randomly with a mix of base, wall and high cabinets.

 

 

Measurement start: Click on the “See your item list” icon from the top right options of the planner.

Measurement End: When the complete item list is displayed as shown below.

Scenario 6:   Save Drawing

“Login” at the landing page by click on “your saved designs”

User: catchpoint@ikea.com  Password:  Pinglan72

Click on “design from scratch” to get into the planner. Click on “make it yours” and follow steps in “Scenario 5” to populate the planner with 15 cabinets randomly.

Measurement Start:  Click on the save icon on the top right corner of the planner.

Enter name and description and then click on “Save”. Measurement starts when the user clicks on “Save”

Measurement End: When the below pop-up is displayed stating “Great, your design has been saved!”
